mods.name: Fuel On Demand
mods.tagline: Fuel Saver - Stop Fuel Waste - Forge and Campfire Auto Off (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Forges, campfires and chem stations burn fuel only while they are actually working. No overburn on the last item, the fire goes out when the craft queue empties, and a jammed station goes dark until you make room. Leftover fuel is kept. Empty stations still burn for heat. Server-side only; players install nothing.

mods.name: Nearby Storage
mods.tagline: Craft From Containers and QuickStack (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Craft from storage containers, quick stack and fetch — client-side, nothing to install on the server (EAC off). The crafting window counts nearby boxes as your backpack, and Craft pulls what it needs. One key stashes your haul into every box around you; another fetches back exactly what you're short of. Formerly Stash n' Fetch.

mods.name: Accessory Slots
mods.tagline: More Things to Wear
mods.summary: Extra equipment slots on a new Accessories tab: a necklace, a bracelet and two rings by default, and other mods add their own - like Glider's. Worn items give their bonuses like armor, follow your world's armor rules on death, and can show on your character. A framework: install it for a mod that uses it. Server and every client, EAC off.

mods.name: Drone Automation Kit
mods.tagline: Junk Drones Do Your Chores (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Server-side 7 Days to Die mod: junk-drone modules that automate chores while the drone follows you. Auto-Loot, Auto-Salvage, Auto-Harvest, Auto-Repair and Auto-Plant all work as if you did it yourself; Auto-Defense makes the drone an ammo-fed bodyguard; Overclock and Wide-Band Antenna boost the rest. Craftable, quality-scaled.

mods.name: POI Map
mods.tagline: Every POI Named and Searchable (Client-Side)
mods.summary: The vanilla map shows terrain and your own way points — not one point of interest. This puts them all on it: tier-colored, named on hover, listed by distance in a searchable panel. Then it tells you what is inside each one — books, cars, guns, crops, safes — and how many sleepers are waiting. Plus the preview render the game never shows.

mods.name: Turret Resupply
mods.tagline: Auto Turrets Reload From Your Ammo Boxes (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Turrets reload themselves from your storage boxes. Keep ammo in a box near your turrets and traps and they stay loaded - with the ammo you chose (AP stays AP), or the best in the box if you never chose. A turret that ran dry is re-armed. Never a box a player has open. Server-side only: players install nothing.

mods.name: Glider
mods.tagline: Jump Off Anything and Float Down Like a Parachute
mods.summary: Deployable gliders: jump, then jump again in mid-air to open a wing and float down from any roof, cliff or tower. Five gliders from a scrap parachute to the gas-thrust Thruster Wings, worn packed on your back, five glider mods with quality, vehicle-style steering. Requires Accessory Slots. Server and every client, EAC off.

mods.name: More Biomes
mods.tagline: Swamp and Blended Borders
mods.summary: New biomes. A swamp with bald cypress, crocodiles, mist, ponds, peat, loot and a trading post. Thickets of dense forest full of deer, rabbits and boar. A transition biome along every border, so snow no longer meets desert at a wall. World generation paints them into every new world. Server + every client, EAC off.

mods.name: ScoutMap
mods.tagline: MiniMap That Knows the Buildings (Client-Side)
mods.summary: A HUD minimap that names what you are looking at. Every point of interest is drawn and coloured by tier, and the building you are standing in is named under the map. Hostiles appear only once they are awake and already hunting you. Runs entirely on your own client, including on dedicated servers that have never heard of it.

mods.name: Zipline
mods.tagline: Ride a Cable Between Buildings
mods.summary: Ride a steel cable between rooftops, up to 512 blocks a span. Slide down on gravity, haul back up hand over hand, or wire in a generator for a motor both ways. New worlds hide a few old ziplines on forest-town rooftops to find. Riders count as in a vehicle on horde night. Idea by Liz (More2Me 4Life). Server + every client, EAC off.

mods.name: Auto Nailgun
mods.tagline: Hold It and Your Base Repairs and Upgrades Itself (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Hold your nailgun in your own land claim: every damaged block around you is repaired and every block that can climb a tier does - frames to wood to cobble to concrete to steel - at vanilla cost, XP and swing speed. It stops where your materials do, and stands down on blood moon. Client-side; servers install nothing.

mods.name: Mega Trees (25x)
mods.tagline: One Seed and the Wood of 25 (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Server-side mod (Game V3.0+) for 25x mega trees: combine 25 saplings into one giant that harvests like 25 trees. Eight species including a coal-bearing burnt pine. Saves space, cuts tree count.

mods.name: Loot Magnet
mods.tagline: Loot That Collects Itself (Server-Side)
mods.summary: A placeable block that loots nearby bags, containers and dropped items as if you opened them yourself — loot stage, Lucky Looter and loot buffs all apply. Chain storage chests onto it and the haul spreads across them, topping off matching stacks first. Upgrade it in place through three tiers for more reach and speed. Server-side only.

mods.name: Control Panel
mods.tagline: Mod Settings and Hotkeys in One Screen (Client-Side)
mods.summary: One settings screen for every mod you have, and one place that finally tells you which of them are fighting over the same key. Tune any mod from inside the game — mine or anyone else's — and see every hotkey on your install in one table, with the collisions called out and the free keys listed.

mods.name: SteadyFrame
mods.tagline: Horde-Night FPS and Performance (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Makes horde night cheaper, not smaller. A server-side mod that attacks the real per-tick cost of a blood moon — the AI think budget, the block-stability solver, pathfinding — plus a CPU-aware governor that tunes itself to your hardware. The same horde costs the server less, so it stacks on difficulty mods that raise them. Clients install nothin

mods.name: Material Tracker
mods.tagline: Loot and Resource Finder (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Name a material and every place you can get it gets a marker, with real drop odds: trees, plants, ore, cars to salvage, unopened loot, animals, your own boxes. Shift+F2: find anything by name, see every source, track it. Client-side, nothing on the server. Requires EAC off, so it works on servers that allow EAC-off players. Formerly Materialist.

mods.name: SteadyView
mods.tagline: Pick a Frame Rate and It Holds It (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Pick a frame rate and it holds it. Your graphics settings are the ceiling: with headroom it does nothing; without, it gives up quality one small step at a time (render resolution last) and hands it back when it can. New: terrain draws only the biomes present, same picture, up to +19% fps. Client-side.

mods.name: Quest Biome Indicator
mods.tagline: See the Biome Before You Take a Trader Quest (Client-Side)
mods.summary: A trader's job list gives you the tier, the distance and the building — never the biome, which is what really decides how the run goes. Quest Biome adds it to every offered quest, colour-coded, before you accept. Buried supplies included. Works even on servers that don't run it. Client-side, EAC off.

mods.name: Mindless Zombies
mods.tagline: Feral Zombie AI (Server-Side)
mods.summary: EXPERIMENTAL. Vanilla zombies path to your weakest block and pick your base apart. Mindless flattens that: block hardness stops mattering, so they come straight at you and through whatever's in the way. Slower by day, a surge on a blood moon, they enrage when shot and gunfire brings screamers. Server-side — clients install nothing, EAC stays on.

mods.name: Sandbox Settings Randomizer
mods.tagline: Roll a New World Every Time (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Re-roll your game settings on a schedule, streamer-style. Adds a Randomize button and padlocks to the Sandbox Options screen, plus an auto-randomizer that fires manually, every morning, or after each blood moon. Seeded, reproducible, per-save. Install on the server; players can add it too so rolls land without a rejoin. Requires EAC off.

mods.name: Sound Radar
mods.tagline: See What You Cannot Hear (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Play with the sound off and still know what is happening. Arrows at the edge of your screen point at the hostiles you cannot see - direction, real name, and how dangerous it is. Nothing is drawn over the fight: a filled dot is a body still alive, a hollow ring is a noise, and a wall being chewed gets a warning. Client-side; servers install nothing.

mods.name: ProjectZ MasteryMark
mods.tagline: Know Which Books You Can Scrap (Client-Side)
mods.summary: A read perk book is spare the moment you read it. A skill magazine is not — in Project Z, 8 of them craft the mastery magazine above it. This marks the difference: the game's own scrap icon on books with nothing left to give, the count still owed on the ones worth keeping, and a blue mark for a line whose mastery finished without it.

mods.name: Auto Harvest
mods.tagline: Pick Up Crops as You Walk (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Client-side, works on any server. Walk past a plant and it gets picked: hold R with fists or a knife to switch it on, and goldenrod, cotton and the rest are picked as you walk - your own crops too if you say so. Your swing speed, your stamina, your bags. Leaves other players' claims alone. Control Panel support. Game 2.6-3.3, EAC off.

mods.name: Vanilla Fixes
mods.tagline: Thirteen Base-Game Bugs Patched
mods.summary: Thirteen bugs in the base game, one mod. Note quests stuck on NO TRADER or never resetting, dead underground treasure maps, animals that stop respawning, and seven from the official forum: 3.4 slot locks, no party XP for fire kills, broken drones, ally vehicles emptied, (Empty) collectors, a helmet light nobody else sees.

mods.name: Queue Priority
mods.tagline: Reorder and Split Your Crafting Queue (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Vanilla gives you one gesture on a queued craft: cancel it and take the ingredients back. Alt + click a queue slot to craft it next, Alt + right-click to send it to the back - and Alt + right-click the job in progress to split it, so the one in the pan finishes and the rest waits its turn. Client-side; works on servers that don't have it.

mods.name: Autopilot
mods.tagline: Drive Walk or Fly to Your Waypoint (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Client-side, works on any server. Set a map marker, press Alt+\ and be taken there - on foot, bicycle, minibike, motorcycle or 4x4, round cliffs, water, trees and zombies, through a trader's gate by honking it open. A gyrocopter takes off, flies there and can land itself. Take the controls back any time. Game 3.2-3.3, EAC off.

mods.name: Fuel Top-Off
mods.tagline: One Key Fuels the Whole Queue (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Queue half an hour of crafting on five minutes of wood and vanilla lets the fire go out. Press one key inside a forge, campfire or chemistry station and exactly enough wood or coal goes in from your backpack to see the whole queue through - and it lights the station if it had gone out. Client-side; servers install nothing.

mods.name: Mod Finder
mods.tagline: Every Mod That Fits (Client-Side)
mods.summary: Client-side, works on any server. Open Modify and a panel lists every mod that fits that weapon, tool or armor: what each one does, what it would change on that item (green/red stats), and where to get it - in your bag, craftable, which schematic, or loot only. Install with one click. Game 3.0-3.3, EAC off.

mods.name: ProjectZ-WalkerSims Boss Fix
mods.tagline: Vanilla Boss Rates Restored (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Running WalkerSim2 on a ProjectZ server? Snow, desert and burnt forest turn into boss conveyor belts at night — 65-72% of the biome spawn pool becomes 30,000-240,000 HP bosses. WalkerSim disables the vanilla biome spawner, removing the maxcount cap that kept them rare. This puts that rarity back. Server-side XML, no DLL.

mods.name: Chat Events
mods.tagline: Let Your Chat Drop Hordes Bosses and Debuffs on You (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Hand your chat the controls. Console-callable buffs any bot fires with buffplayer: trip them, burn them, blur their screen, or drop a gamestage-scaled horde or a boss on their head. Server-side only, no dependencies. Project Z, if installed, adds 60 more meter buffs. A redeem never spawns nothing - buy too high and it downgrades and multiplies.

mods.name: Would You Rather
mods.tagline: Pick Your Poison (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Every 15 minutes of play, each player picks one of two deals - each a perk AND a curse. Faster legs but glass bones? Infinite ammo but half your health? 144 effects in three tiers (everyday, high stakes, wild) as per-player buffs that stack all week and reset after horde night. Server-side: answer in chat, or install it too for a popup.

mods.name: Rocket Car
mods.tagline: Electric Jet Car That Jumps and Kickflips
mods.summary: An electric open-wheel jet car. Boost on compressed air, jump, kickflip and front or back flip in mid-air, land soft on its jets, and stay planted in hard turns on its suction fans. Charge it at its own charger block or with charge cells. Seats two, learned with the 4x4. Game 3.0-3.3, server and clients, EAC off.

mods.name: Player Beacon
mods.tagline: Let Your Bot See Vehicles Claims and Traders (Server-Side)
mods.summary: Your bot can read a player's position and health, and nothing else that matters. Player Beacon publishes what a server console cannot see - is this player on a vehicle, in a land claim, or inside a trader area - as plain CVars you read with "cvar get". Server-side, XML only, read-only. Clients install nothing.

mods.name: Hidden Passcodes (Server-Side)
mods.summary: 7 Days to Die draws your storage passcode in plain text while you type it, so it is readable on stream, in a recording, on a shared screen or over a shoulder. This masks it to dots and adds the game's own reveal button. Server-side and XML-only: clients install nothing and EAC stays on.

mods.name: Dread
mods.tagline: Halloween Horror and Fear Meter (Server-Side)
mods.summary: EARLY ACCESS. Seven nights of Halloween horror, each worse than the last: a fear meter, a world that creaks and goes dark, things that are not there, and something that hunts you. Night 7 is Halloween. Trick-or-treat, grave robbing. Single player or server; joiners install nothing.

unreleased.name: Auto Miner
unreleased.tagline: Look at the Ore and the Seam Gets Mined
unreleased.summary: Look at ore with a pickaxe or an auger in your hands and the seam around it is mined for you, with a waste budget for the rock between the lumps. It never touches player-built blocks.

unreleased.name: Battle Log
unreleased.summary: Records everything that takes health off your bar, including the buffs that drain you with no hit marker and no attacker, so an unexplained death has an answer.

unreleased.name: Blueprint Ghost
unreleased.summary: Save a structure you built as a blueprint, then project it anywhere as a translucent ghost that shows only the blocks still missing, with a running total of the materials left to gather.

unreleased.name: Confetti Shotgun
unreleased.summary: Adds the Confetti Choke, a shotgun attachment that sprays confetti out of the barrel on every shot. Pure XML on vanilla assets.

unreleased.name: Drone Hive
unreleased.summary: Worker drones with one job each, and you can run several at once: a Harvester parks on your farm and reaps and replants it, a Salvager follows you and strips wrecks, and a hive block takes whatever they collect.

unreleased.name: Focus
unreleased.tagline: Live Goal Coach and XP Meter
unreleased.summary: Reads your live character and names the most valuable thing to do next for the goal you picked, and shows where your XP actually came from over the last hour.

unreleased.name: Horde Path
unreleased.tagline: See How Zombies Will Reach You
unreleased.summary: Draws the routes zombies will take to where you stand, before horde night, using the game's own pathfinder: where they walk, where they break a block and where they drop.

unreleased.name: Master Station
unreleased.tagline: Put Your Spare Workstations to Work
unreleased.summary: A Master Workbench and a Master Chemistry Station with three module slots each. Every module is built from a real workstation and works like another bench crafting alongside the master.

unreleased.name: Party Claims
unreleased.summary: While you share a party you count as allies inside each other's land claims, so the group you play with can build, repair and upgrade in your base. The access ends the moment the party does.

unreleased.name: Sandbox Tuner
unreleased.summary: Turns the numbers a modpack baked into its XML into real sandbox options and an admin-editable config file, so a server owner can retune a pack without editing it. Early prototype.

unreleased.name: Storage Portal
unreleased.summary: Write a name on a storage box and every box carrying that name is the same store, anywhere in the world. A box with no name stays an ordinary private box.

unreleased.name: Storefront
unreleased.summary: Replaces the simulated customer behind player vending machines: price decides how fast something sells, sales come in bundles, demand runs dry if you flood the shelf, and where you place a machine matters.

unreleased.name: Trader Radio
unreleased.summary: Visit a trader once and check their shelf from anywhere afterwards: full stock and prices in the normal trade window, how far away they are and how long until they restock. A listing only, no remote buying.

unreleased.name: Trader Transit
unreleased.summary: Stand in a trader compound, type /tt and pay a fare in dukes to travel to another trader you have already found. Fares scale with distance, and the radio goes dead on blood moons.

unreleased.name: Turret Targeting
unreleased.tagline: Tell Your Turrets What to Shoot
unreleased.summary: Adds a target filter to every turret and motion sensor: low-tier zombies only, ferals and tougher, demolishers only, everything except birds. Runs on the server; a client install adds the picker to the turret window.
